messages:
lucy-cs: Heads up — ACME opened a billing + correctness escalation. They saw duplicate text chunks after a quick reconnect during an SSE stream and got billed for both. They've asked for a credit and a root-cause. Posting their repro + logs below so eng can triage.

ben-oncall: Thanks Lucy. Is this SSE (GET streaming) or WebSocket? Any example request/headers?

lucy-cs: SSE (GET). Customer pasted this as their reproduce steps: 

```
# Repro (from customer)
1) Start SSE: 
   curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-2&session=acme-abc\"
2) Wait for first chunk to arrive (seq=0) then force-close client (CTRL-C)
3) Immediately reconnect with the same session param but client did NOT send resume token
4) Server responds with rest of stream but the first chunk is sent again -> duplicate output seen by client and duplicate billed tokens
```

They also included a short server log excerpt (redacted keys):

```
[2026-03-14T16:02:01Z] stream:start session=acme-abc prompt_hash=0x5f3a
[2026-03-14T16:02:02Z] chunk: seq=0 gen_id=abcd123 content=\"Hello, \"
[2026-03-14T16:02:03Z] conn: closed by client
[2026-03-14T16:02:03Z] conn: reconnect session=acme-abc resume_token=\"\"
[2026-03-14T16:02:03Z] stream:exec new run gen_id=efgh456
[2026-03-14T16:02:03Z] chunk: seq=0 gen_id=efgh456 content=\"Hello, \"
```

Note: gen_id changed on replay in their trace. Customer claims they saw the exact same text twice and was charged for both generations.

maya-sdk: Ok — quick behavioral note: if the client reconnects without a resume token we treat that as a new request (stateless resume not possible). For SSE our SDK normally does: send `x-resume-token` when available and `Idempotency-Key` on initial request so server can dedupe on high level. If neither is present the runtime may re-run the model.

ravi-ml: The log shows the server executed a fresh run (new gen_id). That explains duplicate tokens. Two mitigations: (1) client must attempt resume token on reconnect so server can stitch/KV-reuse and avoid re-run, (2) server-side should try to detect "fast reconnect" and avoid charging until resume decision is resolved.

ben-oncall: Can someone paste an exact curl that reproduces this so I can run in staging? Also need to know if the customer used any `Idempotency-Key` header.

lucy-cs: Customer said they were using a simple browser client and did not set idempotency. Example repro command they provided: 

```bash
# start (in one terminal)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-2&session=acme-abc"
# quickly kill after first chunk
# restart immediately in another terminal (no resume token header)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-2&session=acme-abc"
```

maya-sdk: Short-term SDK mitigation: we'll update the JS/browser SDK within a patch to always capture and persist a resume token as soon as the first SSE `event: resume_token` arrives, and then automatically include it on reconnect attempts for the same session id. That should fix most accidental replays from flaky mobile/browser reconnects. Working on PR now. :hammer_and_wrench:

dana-billing: From billing side — we need to issue a provisional credit for the duplicate run while this is investigated. Please confirm: do we have a deterministic way to identify duplicates in logs (prompt_hash + customer session + close delta < N seconds)? If yes I can queue a manual credit for ACME and block automated collections for these runs.

ravi-ml: We can add a quick heuristic: if two runs for same session/prompt_hash start within 5s and the first returned at least one chunk before disconnect, flag as potential replay. We can surface candidate duplicates to billing pipeline. Longer-term we should implement a generation-level dedupe check: compute rolling prefix hash of first N tokens and if new run prefix hash matches recent run, drop charging for the replayed prefix.

ben-oncall: Immediate engineering mitigation we can deploy in staging today: when a reconnect arrives with empty resume_token but session id matches a run that ended <3s ago and prompt_hash matches, do not immediately start a fresh model run — instead put connection into a short 2s "resume window" while we check for a trailing resume token from client. If none arrives, then proceed. That will avoid hot reconnect races. I'll open a small PR and a flag to enable in prod.

reconnect-bot: CI job started: https://ci.internal/redwood/streams/replay-guard/1234 — test suite includes the customer repro.

lucy-cs: Dana — thanks. Please proceed with provisional credit and mention we'll follow up when engineering fixes land. ACME is sensitive so they'd like a 48-72 hour turnaround.

dana-billing: I issued provisional credit (internal ticket BILL-789). Will hold until eng confirms.

maya-sdk: Action items from SDK: add persistent resume token store for browser client, include `Idempotency-Key` on initial request (fallback to session+prompt-hash if not present). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/456 (ETA: 24h).

ben-oncall: Action items from runtime: (1) feature-flagged resume-window guard (2s default), (2) short-term heuristic report to billing, (3) long term prefix-hash dedupe design doc. I'll take 1 & 2, Ravi pls own design doc. ETA for 1&2: 48h to staging, 72h to prod behind flag.

ravi-ml: Will draft the dedupe design doc today and include cost model for "dropped rerun tokens" vs. edge false-positives.

lucy-cs: Thanks team — I'll reply to ACME with the provisional credit and the 48-72h timeline. Please add notes in the support case with links to PRs/CI. :thumbsup:

ben-oncall: I'll run the customer's repro in staging once the guard flag is up and paste outputs here.

reconnect-bot: Staging run results: https://ci.internal/redwood/streams/replay-guard/1234/results — preliminary: repro fails to duplicate when guard is enabled.

lucy-cs: Perfect. I'll update ACME and close the high-priority billing escalation if billing confirms credit.

ben-oncall: Leaving follow-ups: add metrics for "resume-window triggered" + "duplicate-prefix-detected", so we can monitor post-deploy.

maya-sdk: I'll also add a short note to the SDK changelog and an example snippet in docs recommending clients always persist resume token and set Idempotency-Key.

lucy-cs: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Keep me posted if any customer-visible changes deviate from the plan.
